description: Sliding glass door repair in Hollywood starts at the sill: older tracks, clogged weep holes, salt near the beach, and who signs off on a new door here.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in Hollywood
subline: Three out of four Hollywood homes were built before 1980, and on doors that age the sill track tells us more than the glass.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in Hollywood usually starts at the bottom track. Most homes here predate 1980, and decades of sand, salt and rain wear the sill, clog the weep holes and grind the rollers. Fix the track first, then the rollers and lock. A replacement needs a permit and an HVHZ-approved door.
faqHeading: Questions about older Hollywood doors and leaks
closing: Send us photos of the track, both bottom corners of the panel and any label on the glass, or call, and we'll tell you where the problem starts.

faqs.q: Why does my Hollywood slider leak only when rain blows sideways?
faqs.a: Wind pushes water into the sill faster than the weep holes can drain it. A Florida Building Commission report cites FEMA findings that wind-driven rain in Hurricane Ian entered homes mainly through sliding doors and soffits. Clear the weep holes and check the track for pitting or a bent lip.

faqs.q: Does a house in a Hollywood historic district need approval for a new sliding door?
faqs.a: It may. Hollywood has historic districts, including the Lakes Area district and the Hollywood Beach Historic Overlay District, and a Historic Preservation Board that rules on Certificates of Appropriateness. Ask the city's planning staff before ordering a door that changes how the house looks.

faqs.q: Why do sliders near Hollywood Beach need more upkeep than ones further inland?
faqs.a: Salt. It settles in the sill track, stays damp after rain and speeds up corrosion on rollers, screws and lock parts. Our founder's experience is that homes near the ocean need maintenance more often than inland homes, so clean the track more often.

faqs.q: Can a 1960s sliding door in Hollywood still be repaired?
faqs.a: Often, if the frame and bottom rail are sound. New rollers, a track cap and lock work can keep an old aluminum door going. The limit is parts: if the model can't be identified or its rollers aren't made anymore, replacement may be the honest answer.

faqs.q: Who has to approve a new balcony slider in a Hollywood condo building?
faqs.a: Usually two parties: the association or building management, and the city through a building permit. Broward is in the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone, so the door also needs a product approval that covers that zone. Get the association's requirements in writing before ordering.
